rationale: Bifidobacterium adolescentis ferments lactate and glucose to acetate and CO₂ via the bifid shunt. Arginine provides both carbon and nitrogen; ammonium is assimilated. Nitrogen is limiting at 57 mmol/L input vs. 8 mmol/L growth cost, supporting ~0.35 /h growth. Carbon is balanced: 81 mmol C in covers 11.55 (biomass) + 33 (products) + fermentation intermediates. This strategy maintains robust growth in the remaining 16 hours of the batch.
